visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler with pigtails in a light patterned top runs through a modern living room towards a staircase. (2) She enters a bedroom and approaches a grey crib where a younger sister is sleeping; she leans over the mesh side to wake her. (3) In a bright kitchen, a woman in a black t-shirt prepares fruit milk at a wooden table with both children seated in high chairs. (4) The older child pours milk into a blender cup while the woman stabilizes it; bowls of sliced bananas sit nearby. (5) The woman activates a black blender; the pigtail girl laughs and sticks her tongue out at the noise. (6) The woman pours a thick yellow smoothie into a measuring cup for the girls to share. (7) A spill occurs, covering a section of the wooden table in white liquid; the woman cleans it with white tissues while laughing. (8) The girls drink from their respective cups, one green with a straw and one pink; they exhibit various facial expressions of concentration and joy. (9) A second orange-hued drink is blended and served; the children applaud with their hands. (10) The video ends on a pink background with a cartoon character logo and text.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A mother in a black graphic t-shirt and two young daughters, one with pigtails in a beige patterned top and another in a light grey ribbed shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern home interior featuring a light-colored wooden floor, a white kitchen with stainless steel appliances (fridge, oven, mixer), a wooden dining table, and a children's bedroom with a crib.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic guitar and synth-based BGM starts. A woman's energetic voice and a child's excited vocalizations set a cheerful tone. (2) A mechanical click sound of a door opening occurs. A child's voice yells 'wake up' with high pitch and arousal. (3) Sound of liquid pouring with a wet, gurgling acoustic signature is heard. Background chatter between two adults and children creates a busy kitchen environment. (4) A low-pitched percussive thud signifies objects being dropped into a bowl. (5) A sustained, high-intensity mechanical whirring sound of a blender engine masks the voices briefly. A child's high-frequency giggle is audible over the motor. (6) A sharp splashing sound and a sudden vocal exclamation indicate a spill incident. (7) Sounds of paper rustling and light wiping occur amidst playful conversational banter about taste. (8) The blender whirring returns for a second session, followed by the sound of rhythmic clapping and cheering from the children. (9) Slurping sounds and the hollow clinking of plastic cups against the table surface are heard. (10) The audio concludes with a short, bright synth jingle matching the brand transition.
